node.statement: Let A=mu(U,V) and B=mu(V,W). Assume ||mu(A,W)-A bold-dot W||<=84*epsilon_r, ||A bold-dot W-(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W||<=171*epsilon_r, ||U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)-U bold-dot B||<=171*epsilon_r, and ||U bold-dot B-mu(U,B)||<=84*epsilon_r. Using the associator estimate from the preceding child as the middle link, the triangle inequality along mu(A,W), A bold-dot W, (U bold-dot V) bold-dot W, U bold-dot(V bold-dot W), U bold-dot B, mu(U,B) gives ||mu(A,W)-mu(U,B)||<=(84+171+8+171+84)*epsilon_r=518*epsilon_r<=520*epsilon_r. Since A=mu(U,V) and B=mu(V,W), this is exactly ||mu(mu(U,V),W)-mu(U,mu(V,W))||<=520*epsilon_r.
